mechanism.claim: During elevated completed Rogers-Satchell variation, an unusually one-sided decomposition of the estimator into upper and lower open/close-adjusted excursion energy marks asymmetric rejection. Fade the dominant excursion side for eight hours.
mechanism.side: short when summed upper RS energy exceeds summed lower RS energy; long on the strict reverse
mechanism.why_distinct: Raw wick imbalance subtracts candle shadows, range traversal uses extreme ordering, and drawup/drawdown asymmetry follows path-ordered extrema. HVRSAR aggregates six canonical logarithmic Rogers-Satchell upper and lower products, normalizes their difference by total RS energy, and uses no volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the total completed RS estimator must rank in its causal upper 35% and absolute directional decomposition in its upper quartile
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: offset four-hour open/close-adjusted range-energy asymmetry onsets are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.window: latest six exact coherent four-hour bars, twenty-four completed hours
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 earlier source-valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.asymmetry_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(excursion_asymmetry) on the same 270/180 basis; rank>=0.75
features.eligible_state: both ranks pass and excursion_asymmetry is strict nonzero
features.onset: eligible now and immediately previous exact source-valid decision ineligible; missing prior cannot trigger
features.recursive_reset: six-bar windows and both rank histories reset after any invalid four-hour bar

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical additive Rogers-Satchell upper/lower energy decomposition under the requested volatile regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no RS window, decomposition, ranks, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: Rogers-Satchell volatility; QuantConnect LEAN canonical implementation
external_basis.fixed_definition: per bar upper=ln(H/C)*ln(H/O), lower=ln(L/C)*ln(L/O), RS=sqrt(mean(upper+lower)); valid strict positive OHLC
external_basis.selection_use: official estimator and its additive upper/lower terms only; directional fade and 24h aggregation are explicitly untested adaptations; no incidence or outcomes
